s1.syndrome_frame: Acute chest pain with pleuritic and intermittent characteristics, associated with diaphoresis and elevated troponin levels, in a young adult with recent onset of systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain
No family history of cardiovascular disease
ECG showed sinus rhythm with benign early repolarization
Negative serum viral and autoantibody screens

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute chest pain with pleuritic and intermittent characteristics, associated with diaphoresis and elevated troponin levels, in a young adult with recent onset of systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain
No family history of cardiovascular disease
ECG showed sinus rhythm with benign early repolarization
Negative serum viral and autoantibody screens

differentials: Marfan syndrome with aortic root dilatation
Mitral valve prolapse with mitral annular disjunction
per_call: Marfan syndrome with aortic root dilatation
Mitral valve prolapse with mitral annular disjunction

shortlist.label: Myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated troponin levels, recent onset of systemic inflammation, and evidence of myocardial edema on CMR

shortlist.label: Acute coronary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated high-sensitivity troponin T and evidence of hypokinesia on CMR

shortlist.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and evidence of myocardial inflammation

shortlist.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patchy late gadolinium enhancement on CMR and recent onset of systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Pleuritic chest pain and elevated C-reactive protein, although no pericardial effusion was seen on echocardiography

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with sharp, central chest pain, diaphoresis, and elevated high-sensitivity troponin T, along with the cardiac magnetic resonance imaging findings of mild systolic dysfunction, hypokinesia, and extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement, are consistent with myocarditis. The absence of coronary artery disease risk factors and the lack of pericardial effusion also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's young age, lack of family history of cardiovascular disease, and absence of significant coronary artery disease risk factors make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated myocarditis
rejected.why: While the patient has a recent diagnosis of ulcerative colitis, the cardiac findings are not specific to this condition and can be explained by myocarditis alone.

rejected.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of granulomatous disease or other systemic symptoms suggestive of sarcoidosis.

rejected.label: Pericarditis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not suggest pericardial involvement, and the cardiac magnetic resonance imaging did not show pericardial effusion.
